market.name: Israeli Insurance Market
market.industry_context: Insurance industry in Israel including car insurance, health insurance, life insurance, travel insurance, home insurance, insurance comparison platforms, and insurance agents

domain_types.ai_description: Official insurance company website selling their own insurance products directly. These are licensed insurance carriers in Israel.
Insurance price comparison platforms that aggregate quotes from multiple insurance companies. Direct competitors in the comparison space.
Independent insurance agents or agencies that represent multiple insurance companies. Not the insurance carriers themselves.
User-generated content platforms including forums, Q&A sites, social media, and community discussion sites
Third-party websites including news sites, review platforms, government sites, financial portals, and informational content not directly selling insurance
